topology.eligibility_note: Conservative scope restriction of the interior-only prototype, not proof or calibration of wall hydrodynamics.
topology.alternative_selection: F5 late aggregation; first F8 persistent split; first saved frame preceding final persistent merge by at least 0.25ms in completed F10D prepare1101/1102; existing geometric B2 histories as no-event controls. No random generation or translation.
topology.restart: New cross-model counterfactual with explicit absolute-time offset, original fixed controls, reinitialized coordinate caches and graph; no exact B2 checkpoint claim. Past M0 dwell not transferred.
topology.half_step_gate: Complete DT10 and original quality PASS; at least one new persistent event or unresolved right-censored event with scientific value; no additional candidate after failed short trajectory.

navigation.historical_target_note: F10A preregistered +1um Z diagnostic target was at original X, not a downstream navigation gate. The +20um plane is a retrospective diagnostic and prospective F10L proposal, not an original navigation success claim.
navigation.interpolation: Piecewise linear between actual saved centroids; report brackets and cadence, compare dt pairs; no mean-velocity extrapolation.

scaling.stop_rule: No higher N after unresolved convergence/quality failure or projected same-family solve>=10s; no repeat when single solve>=8s; hard watchdog10s; missing result NOT_RUN or TIME_BUDGET_EXCEEDED.
scaling.synthetic: One contiguous nearly touching simple-cubic lattice, 0.001R initial overlap; deterministic weak isotropic compression free=-1*(x-centroid) s^-1; same radius, no independent replicated subclusters. Benchmark only, no acoustics/CFD claim.
